t: Milwaukee Shockwave 1/4" 50mm Hex Shank PH2 Impact Screwdriver Bits are engineered for professional impact driving. These durable screwdriver bits are ideal for electricians, plumbers, and general builders tackling heavy-duty fastening tasks on site. Featuring laser-hardened Wear Guard Tip technology, they enhance wear resistance and maintain a precise fit for prolonged use. Optimised Shockzone geometry flexes to absorb impacts, significantly reducing stress at the tip and minimising breakages. Manufactured from custom-engineered steel, these PH2 impact driver accessories offer increased resistance to high-torque impact driving, ensuring reliability for demanding jobs.
